newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM boosts Schiphiol's Oct freight growth.
newsitem.headline: KLM boosts Schiphiol's Oct freight growth.

text.p: Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport handled 13.5 percent more airfreight in October than a year ago, reflecting strong growth of the leading Dutch airline KLM, the airport's operating company said.
Schiphol's statistics department said the airport handled 98,162 tonnes of airfreight last month.

Releasing the airport's provisional figures for October, it said the increase was partly due to a lower growth rate in the comparable month this time last year, and due to growth of KLM Cargo, the airline's airfreight division, the actvities of which represent hald the total air cargo handled at Schiphol.
It said the trend of recent months of an increase in air transport movements continued. In October, there were a total of 28,780 movements, up 13.4 per cent on this time last year.

The airport said the charter market remains weak, both in terms of numbers of passengers carried and in the number of air transport movements. However, there was a 16 per cent increase in the number of transit passengers at Schiphol.
